runs.bootstrapPolicy: Original restore() pauses a playing checkpoint; resume() is called once and its bootstrap event is drained outside the recorded observation. The prior pending event queue is not present in the checkpoint. No event is inserted into or removed from the compared recorded stream.

metrics.timingScope: Recorded Game.tick loops, one original drain per callback, recorded-event JSON copies, clock reads and small per-frame observation records only. Restore, input validation/cloning, final checkpoint, comparisons, hashing and output are outside this interval. No warmup is added.

runs.note: Diagnostic replay of recorded original Game.tick arguments and one observed event drain after each app callback. Restore/resume happen before timing; the bootstrap resume event is separated from the observation boundary. No renderer, interpolation, HUD, audio, browser scheduling or storage is executed. Node call-wall/CPU timings are not browser frame costs, GPU execution or presented FPS. Checkpoints omit initial particles/texts/links, shake/flash, the pending event queue and navigation caches; a later-time trace can therefore diverge. No UI actions, RNG correction, HP changes, synthetic invulnerability, automatic upgrade choices or numerical tolerances are applied. Exact means strict JSON structural equality (array order preserved); a mismatch is reported, never repaired. V8 CPU profiles also include import/restore/validation/reporting overhead outside the timed replay; distinguish those call trees from Game.tick.
